v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

text.la: Ibant paréntes Iesu * per omnes annos in Ierúsalem, in die solémni Paschæ.
text.en: The parents of Jesus * went to Jerusalem every year, at the feast of the Passover.

text.la: Cum redírent, * remánsit puer Iesus in Ierúsalem, et non cognovérunt paréntes eius.
text.en: When they returned, * the Child Jesus tarried behind in Jerusalem, and His parents knew not of it.

text.la: Non inveniéntes * Iesum, regréssi sunt in Ierúsalem requiréntes eum; et post tríduum invenérunt illum in templo sedéntem in médio doctórum, audiéntem et interrogántem eos.
text.en: When they found not Jesus, * they turned back again to Jerusalem, seeking Him; and after three days they found Him in the Temple, sitting in the midst of the Doctors, both hearing them and asking them questions.

text.la: Dixit Mater eius * ad illum: Fili, quid fecísti nobis sic? Ecce pater tuus, et ego doléntes quærebámus te.
text.en: His mother said unto Him: * Son, why hast Thou thus dealt with us? Behold, thy father and I have sought thee sorrowing.

text.la: Descéndit Iesus * cum eis, et venit Názareth, et erat súbditus illis.
text.en: Jesus went down with them, * and came to Nazareth, and was subject unto them.

text.la: Ecce fidélis servus * et prudens, quem constítuit Dóminus super famíliam suam.
text.en: Behold a faithful * and wise servant, whom his Lord hath made ruler over His household.

text.la: Sanctíssimæ Genetrícis tuæ sponsi, quǽsumus, Dómine, méritis adiuvémur; ut quod possibílitas nostra non óbtinet, eius nobis intercessióne donétur.
text.en: Help us, we beseech thee, O Lord, for the sake of the Husband of thy most holy Mother, that what we cannot for ourselves obtain, Thou mayest grant us at his petition.

text.la: Príncipes sacerdótum consílium fecérunt ut Iesum occíderent: dicébant autem: Non in die festo, ne forte tumúltus fíeret in pópulo.
text.en: The chief Priests consulted that they might kill Jesus, but they said: Not on the Feast-day, lest there be an uproar among the people.

v.la: Éripe me, Dómine, ab hómine malo.
v.en: Deliver me, O Lord, from the evil man.

r.en: Rescue me from the unjust man.

text.la: Concéde, quǽsumus, omnípotens Deus: ut qui protectiónis tuæ grátiam quǽrimus, liberáti a malis ómnibus, secúra tibi mente serviámus.
text.en: Grant, we beseech thee, O Almighty God, that we who seek the grace of thy protection, being delivered from all evils, may serve thee ever in peace and quietness of spirit.
